slides: 8 RULES FOR MEN WHO KEEP MISSING THEIR GOALS
You don't have a plan you have a prayer
Positive thinking without a decision changes nothing
Decide exactly what you want before midnight tonight
Every committed decision triggers a chain reaction
Most men never decide they just hope
You don't need luck you need a decision with a date
Follow for the rules nobody taught you
caption:
Most men fail at self improvement because they hope instead of decide. Discipline and mindset are nothing without a specific target. Success habits begin the second you stop praying and start planning.

Name exactly what you want. Give it a date. Decide before midnight tonight.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
